statement: We studied the complexity of CQs with inequalities and compared the complexity of query answering with and without the inequality constraints. Several questions remain open: Is there a property that gives a dichotomy of query evaluation with inequalities both for the class of CQs, and for the class of CQs along with the inequality graphs? What can be said about unions of conjunctive queries (UCQ) and recursive datalog programs? Can our techniques be used as a black-box to extend any algorithm for CQs, i.e., not necessarily based on SPJ query plans, to evaluate CQs with inequalities?
